podcast.body: The Bee Gees were instrumental in the success of this soundtrack, which became the best-selling album of all time until Michael Jackson's "Thriller." The album's release was carefully coordinated with the movie's marketing, featuring songs like "Stayin' Alive" and "How Deep Is Your Love" that radio stations quickly embraced. "The Bee Gees were about to dominate the pop charts."
